INTERPRETATION RULES
1) AWGN robustness is signal-level; it is not a sea-clutter claim.
2) Truth/SNR may evaluate, but truth/SNR may not decide.
3) Scheduler ranking is never stratified by true SNR.
4) Low-SNR degradation defines a validity boundary; do not retune feature/budget/N3.
5) Interpret branch gain with paired rescue/harm, Wilson CI, cost, and upstream beta error.
6) The primary causal chain is SNR_s -> strong-beta error -> branch validity -> weak recovery.
